# `firearms.combat` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The bullet entity and the server-side combat resolution it drives: flight, hit testing, damage, knockback, pellets, and the spread maths the firing code (FA-6) rolls through (docs/spec/domains/combat.md).

### `class BulletEntity` — `src/main/java/firearms/combat/BulletEntity.java`
A fired shot, or one shotgun pellet, in flight (`docs/spec/domains/combat.md` §3, `04-architecture.md` `ARCH-DEC-004`).
- `BulletEntity(EntityType<? extends BulletEntity> type, Level level)`
- `void shootFrom(Vec3 origin, Vec3 direction, double velocity)` — Positions and launches the bullet; called once by BulletSpawner right after construction.
- `float getDamage()`
- `void setDamage(float damage)`
- `boolean isPellet()`
- `void setPellet(boolean pellet)`
- `void defineSynchedData(SynchedEntityData.Builder builder)`
- `void tick()`
- `void onHitEntity(EntityHitResult hitResult)` — `COMBAT-REQ-004`, `010`: damage via a `firearms:bullet` `DamageSource`, direct = this bullet, causing = the shooter, for free `pvp`/team gating.
- `void onHitBlock(BlockHitResult hitResult)` — `COMBAT-FAIL-002`: removed immediately, no penetration, no ricochet; a small impact particle only.
- `boolean isPickable()`

### `class BulletSpawner` — `src/main/java/firearms/combat/BulletSpawner.java`
The entry point the firing code (FA-6) calls to put a fired shot into the world: one bullet, or a shotgun's independently-spread pellets (`COMBAT-REQ-005`).
- `BulletEntity spawnBullet(ServerLevel level, LivingEntity shooter, Vec3 origin, Vec3 lookDirection, double muzzleVelocity, double spreadDegrees, float damage)` — Spawns one bullet along lookDirection, spread within spreadDegrees of it.
- `List<BulletEntity> spawnPellets(ServerLevel level, LivingEntity shooter, Vec3 origin, Vec3 lookDirection, double muzzleVelocity, double spreadDegrees, float damagePerPellet, int pelletCount)` — Spawns pelletCount independently-spread pellets from one trigger pull (`COMBAT-REQ-005`); the caller consumes exactly one round regardless of pelletCount.

### `class CombatRegistration` — `src/main/java/firearms/combat/CombatRegistration.java`
Registers the bullet entity type as firearms:bullet (`contracts/public-surface.md`), and names the resource key the data-driven firearms:bullet damage type (data/firearms/damage_type/bullet.json) registers under — this class defines neither the damage type's values nor its tag membership, both of which live entirely in data files.
- `ResourceKey<EntityType<?>> BULLET_KEY`
- `EntityType<BulletEntity> BULLET` — `04-architecture.md` `ARCH-DEC-004`: a real, gravity-affected projectile entity, not a hitscan raycast.
- `ResourceKey<DamageType> BULLET_DAMAGE_TYPE` — `COMBAT-REQ-004`: the key `data/firearms/damage_type/bullet.json` registers under.
- `String DEATH_MESSAGE_KEY` — The death message translation keys bullet.json's message_id field (`firearms.bullet`) produces: death.attack.
- `String DEATH_MESSAGE_KEY_PLAYER`
- `void register()`

### `class SpreadMath` — `src/main/java/firearms/combat/SpreadMath.java`
The spread-cone maths a fired shot's initial vector is rolled through (`COMBAT-REQ-001`): a fixed axis direction is rotated by a random angle within a cone half-angle, given two independent uniform samples in [0, 1) the caller draws from the server's own random source.
